title: What's New or Changed in Business Central 2025 Release Wave 1 Update 26.0
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 1 update 26.0 introduces Sales Order Agent for email-based sales order automation, Copilot features for field autofilling and record summarization, Scope 3 value chain sustainability tracking, Field Service integration, and numerous development enhancements including AL language features and telemetry improvements.
features: Field Service integration with service management
Purchase order line matching with Copilot
YAML support in AL with JsonObject
